budget_basis.source: bench/results/benign_spend.json: SWE-smith xml split, n=26076 single-agent runs, total_with_edits
budget_basis.agent_cap: 375: set as p95 rounded up when p95 was 372, kept after later reruns moved p95 to 364 (227a47d) and 362.5 (d9c846e, git show read-only), so it still sits just above p95. A single-agent run hits agent_cap before fleet_budget, so agent_cap sets the benign false-alarm rate: 4.53 asks per 100 runs.
budget_basis.fleet_budget: 2 x agent_cap, so one agent can spend at most half the fleet's window. Not measured: SWE-smith has no multi-agent runs, so this is a single-agent proxy until Bench B (composed fleets).
budget_basis.caveat: Calibrated and measured on the same corpus, not independently validated.
